use-custom-icon.description: Use a custom panel icon (otherwise the theme icon is used)

hotkey.description: Keyboard shortcut to open the menu

show-banner.description: Show the vertical banner on the left

banner-text.description: Banner text (empty = name of your distribution)

frame-opacity.description: Opacity of the outer frame (used only when the theme does not draw the menu with images)

theme-sel-cascades.description: Use the theme's image highlight for the selected row in submenus too

pinned-count.description: Number of favorite programs shown at the top

confirm-power.description: Ask for confirmation on shut down, restart and log off
